instruction:
You are a mechanical piping reviewer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-11 piping network repair and negative-case portfolio.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. Piping network hydraulic review, repair option comparison workflows, pipe thrust support checks, and negative-case verification portfolios shape the workflow context only; they are not extra data sources for this instance.

## Scene

- Product family: `SSC-11-LH-08`
- Baseline network case: `BASE-SSC11-008`
- Repair variant case: `VAR-SSC11-008`
- Support movement note: `SUP-SSC11-008`
- Negative-case register: `VERIFY-SSC11-008`
- Coordination memo: `MEMO-SSC11-008`

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Baseline flow | {{ baseline_flow_l_s }} L/s |
| Variant flow | {{ variant_flow_l_s }} L/s |
| Pipe internal diameter | {{ pipe_internal_diameter_mm }} mm |
| Pipe length | {{ pipe_length_m }} m |
| Darcy friction factor | {{ darcy_friction_factor }} |
| Baseline valve loss coefficient | {{ baseline_valve_loss_coefficient }} |
| Variant valve loss coefficient | {{ variant_valve_loss_coefficient }} |
| Measured support shift | {{ measured_support_shift_m }} m |
| Allowed support shift | {{ allowed_support_shift_m }} m |
| Bend pressure | {{ bend_pressure_kpa }} kPa |
| Bend angle | {{ bend_angle_deg }} degrees |
| Thrust allowable | {{ thrust_allowable_kn }} kN |
| Expected negative cases | {{ expected_negative_cases }} |
| Localized negative cases | {{ localized_negative_cases }} |
| Unresolved repair count | {{ unresolved_repair_count }} |
| Maximum variant velocity | {{ maximum_variant_velocity_m_s }} m/s |

## Checks

- Baseline and variant velocity each equal flow divided by pipe area.
- Baseline and variant headloss each include Darcy major loss and valve minor loss.
- Velocity delta equals variant velocity minus baseline velocity.
- Headloss delta equals variant headloss minus baseline headloss.
- Bend thrust equals `2 x pressure x pipe_area x sin(bend_angle / 2)`.
- Negative-case capture percent equals localized negative cases divided by expected cases times 100.
- Overall pass score is `1.0` only when variant velocity, thrust utilization, support shift, negative-case capture, and unresolved repair checks pass; otherwise it is `0.0`.

## Output Format

Write a compact memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Preserve the object IDs above and state whether the baseline source pack passes the current docs-only checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "baseline_velocity_m_s": <numeric_value>,
  "variant_velocity_m_s": <numeric_value>,
  "velocity_delta_m_s": <numeric_value>,
  "baseline_headloss_m": <numeric_value>,
  "variant_headloss_m": <numeric_value>,
  "headloss_delta_m": <numeric_value>,
  "bend_thrust_kn": <numeric_value>,
  "thrust_utilization": <numeric_value>,
  "support_shift_margin_m": <numeric_value>,
  "negative_case_capture_percent": <numeric_value>,
  "unresolved_repair_count": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```

# ABOUTME: Defines the SSC-11 piping repair and negative-case portfolio template.
# ABOUTME: Pins one synthetic baseline, variant, support, and negative-case source package.

[meta]
name = "piping-network-repair-negative-case-package"
description = "SSC-11 piping repair variant, thrust, support-shift, and negative-case metrics"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound piping network repair metrics from a deterministic SSC-11 task-owned source pack. The template combines baseline and variant hydraulic values, velocity and headloss deltas, bend thrust, support shift margin, negative-case capture, unresolved repair count, and an overall synthetic pass score."
discipline = "mechanical"
category = "piping-review"
standards = ["Piping network hydraulic review", "Repair option comparison workflows", "Pipe thrust support checks", "Negative-case verification portfolios"]
tags = ["mechanical", "piping", "repair", "negative-case", "hydraulics", "support", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.baseline_flow_l_s]
type = "float"
unit = "L/s"
description = "BASE-SSC11-008 baseline flow"
min = 54.977871437821385
max = 54.977871437821385

[params.variant_flow_l_s]
type = "float"
unit = "L/s"
description = "VAR-SSC11-008 repair variant flow"
min = 67.98602851909162
max = 67.98602851909162

[params.pipe_internal_diameter_mm]
type = "float"
unit = "mm"
description = "BASE-SSC11-008 pipe internal diameter"
min = 250.0
max = 250.0

[params.pipe_length_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "BASE-SSC11-008 checked pipe length"
min = 90.0
max = 90.0

[params.darcy_friction_factor]
type = "float"
description = "BASE-SSC11-008 Darcy friction factor"
min = 0.02
max = 0.02

[params.baseline_valve_loss_coefficient]
type = "float"
description = "BASE-SSC11-008 baseline valve loss coefficient"
min = 3.607892219387754
max = 3.607892219387754

[params.variant_valve_loss_coefficient]
type = "float"
description = "VAR-SSC11-008 variant valve loss coefficient"
min = 4.807913565926833
max = 4.807913565926833

[params.measured_support_shift_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "SUP-SSC11-008 measured support shift after repair"
min = 0.05
max = 0.05

[params.allowed_support_shift_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "SUP-SSC11-008 allowed support shift"
min = 0.12
max = 0.12

[params.bend_pressure_kpa]
type = "float"
unit = "kPa"
description = "VAR-SSC11-008 bend pressure"
min = 779.9838540354903
max = 779.9838540354903

[params.bend_angle_deg]
type = "float"
unit = "degrees"
description = "VAR-SSC11-008 bend angle"
min = 30.0
max = 30.0

[params.thrust_allowable_kn]
type = "float"
unit = "kN"
description = "SUP-SSC11-008 thrust allowable"
min = 120.0
max = 120.0

[params.expected_negative_cases]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "VERIFY-SSC11-008 expected negative cases"
min = 4.0
max = 4.0

[params.localized_negative_cases]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "VERIFY-SSC11-008 localized negative cases"
min = 4.0
max = 4.0

[params.unresolved_repair_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "MEMO-SSC11-008 unresolved repairs"
min = 0.0
max = 0.0

[params.maximum_variant_velocity_m_s]
type = "float"
unit = "m/s"
description = "MEMO-SSC11-008 maximum allowed variant velocity"
min = 1.5
max = 1.5

[outputs.baseline_velocity_m_s]
description = "Baseline pipe velocity"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.variant_velocity_m_s]
description = "Repair variant pipe velocity"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.velocity_delta_m_s]
description = "Variant velocity minus baseline velocity"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.baseline_headloss_m]
description = "Baseline major and valve headloss"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.variant_headloss_m]
description = "Variant major and valve headloss"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.headloss_delta_m]
description = "Variant headloss minus baseline headloss"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.bend_thrust_kn]
description = "Variant bend thrust"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.thrust_utilization]
description = "Bend thrust divided by allowable thrust"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.support_shift_margin_m]
description = "Allowed support shift minus measured support shift"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.negative_case_capture_percent]
description = "Localized negative cases divided by expected cases"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.unresolved_repair_count]
description = "Unresolved repair count"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "Pass score for the task-owned repair, support, and negative-case checks"
tolerance = 0.03
